name: Accepted arrivals
numerator_or_summary: Count of accepted adult encounter arrivals
exclusions: duplicate, quarantined, and underage raw rows
unavailable_state: not applicable for an accepted encounter
interpretation_limit: Does not establish demand cause or needed capacity

name: Arrival to triage
numerator_or_summary: Median minutes from arrival to triage
denominator_or_population: Accepted encounters with both valid event times
exclusions: invalid sequence or unavailable arrival or triage
unavailable_state: report unavailable count beside the median
interpretation_limit: Does not identify the cause of delay

name: Arrival to clinician
numerator_or_summary: Median minutes from arrival to first clinician contact
denominator_or_population: Accepted encounters with both valid event times
exclusions: left before seen, invalid sequence, or unavailable clinician time
interpretation_limit: Does not prove a bottleneck or staffing need

name: Arrival to departure
numerator_or_summary: Median minutes from arrival to departure
denominator_or_population: Accepted encounters with a valid complete clock
interpretation_limit: Does not isolate a process stage or cause

name: Left before seen
numerator_or_summary: Accepted encounters with left_before_seen_flag equal to 1
unavailable_state: not available when disposition state is missing
interpretation_limit: Does not explain why an encounter ended before clinician contact

name: Return within 72 hours
numerator_or_summary: Accepted encounters with a later linked return within 72 hours
unavailable_state: report unavailable when person or link token is absent
interpretation_limit: Zero in this synthetic release is not evidence of clinical success

name: Process completion
numerator_or_summary: Accepted encounters with the required terminal state

name: Valid event sequence
numerator_or_summary: Accepted encounters whose required recorded events are nondecreasing
exclusions: none; missing required states fail the validity rule
unavailable_state: retain invalid records but suppress invalid durations
interpretation_limit: Measures data usability rather than service performance

name: Safety event candidate rate
unavailable_state: report unavailable when candidate review is incomplete
interpretation_limit: Candidate frequency is not harm prevalence

name: Trigger sensitivity
numerator_or_summary: Known true synthetic events detected by a trigger
exclusions: none in the generated truth set
unavailable_state: unavailable when known truth is absent
interpretation_limit: Applies only to the synthetic detection system

name: Incident capture sensitivity
numerator_or_summary: Known true synthetic events captured by incident reporting
exclusions: none in the generated truth set
unavailable_state: unavailable when known truth is absent
interpretation_limit: Applies only to synthetic capture and not real reporting culture

name: Completed throughput
exclusions: left before seen or no valid completion
unavailable_state: report unavailable when completion state is unresolved
interpretation_limit: Does not show whether higher throughput is safe or sustainable

name: Queue end
numerator_or_summary: Conserved queue at the end of each 30-minute interval
exclusions: intervals that fail conservation until repaired
unavailable_state: retain unavailable when conservation inputs are missing
interpretation_limit: Does not identify which stage or resource caused a queue

name: Clinician staff hours per arrival
denominator_or_population: Accepted arrivals in the same shift
exclusions: shifts with unavailable hours or zero arrivals
unavailable_state: unavailable when either ratio term is absent
interpretation_limit: Does not authorize staffing change or define adequate coverage

name: Throughput per clinician hour
denominator_or_population: Accepted clinician actual staff hours in the same shift
exclusions: shifts with unavailable or zero clinician hours
unavailable_state: unavailable when either ratio term is absent
interpretation_limit: Is not productivity judgment or a staffing target

name: Overtime hours
unavailable_state: report unavailable when hours cannot be reconstructed
interpretation_limit: Does not prove burden or justify staffing action

name: Supported access-group stratification
numerator_or_summary: Count of eligible accepted encounters by declared support group
exclusions: groups outside the declared synthetic support vocabulary
threshold_origin: minimum 1000 encounters for this teaching release
unavailable_state: suppress comparative interpretation below support threshold
interpretation_limit: Generated group differences do not describe real patients or prove inequity
